findings: MainViewModel now whole-read cumulatively: all 3350 lines covered across v7-v11.
OpenAsync accepts a selection when any member is not deleted, then launches every selected member without filtering deleted members again. No application launch executed.

DelistAsync removes selected result records and renumbers groups but does not call UnmarkOrphanedFiles; directory delisting does call it. Removing an unmarked keeper can therefore leave only marked existing members in a remaining group until refresh or another cleanup; deletion confirmation still warns for fully marked groups.
RefreshAsync does invoke both UnmarkOrphanedFiles and UnlockDeletedGroups, correcting orphan marks after an explicit refresh; it still does not recompare content.
CloseAsync requests cancellation but does not await the running operation before saving preferences and raising Closed. Process-shutdown and worker completion behavior remains unqualified.
FindWithinSearchResults has finally-based busy reset, unlike several previously reviewed commands. Its token is checked while publishing results, not during initial name filtering.
Update download path uses finally to clear busy state. Its external AppUpdater implementation remains opaque; no update request, download or installer execution performed.
